facts.fact: 绞刑处决的是向猎人告密王宫位置的狼
facts.anchor: To watch the wolves that told hunters how to get to the king

facts.fact: 人群中 Winter 认出 Sterling，装作不识
facts.anchor: He knew this human—she haunted his memories. It was her

facts.fact: Winter 自认她是他唯一怜悯过的人类
facts.anchor: The only human he’d ever felt real pity for

facts.fact: 最年轻受刑者（不到二十岁）求饶未完即被踹翻踏板处决
facts.anchor: Winter kicked the block out from beneath him before he could finish speaking

facts.fact: Winter 认出她护住的男孩=当年篮中婴儿 Cyan
facts.anchor: the young woman’s brother, no longer a babe in a basket but a scrawny child

facts.fact: Sterling 当众讽刺王子仁慈
facts.anchor: “I said you’re such a gracious prince.”

facts.fact: Winter 命令尸体挂到蛆生蝇以儆效尤
facts.anchor: “Let them hang until the maggots turn to flies.”

facts.fact: 狼群查明：她叫 Sterling，弟弟 Cyan，经营肉店
facts.anchor: Her name is Sterling, and her kin is Cyan. She owns the meat shop in the market

facts.fact: 屋内干涸狼血味（旧而淡）——她杀狼的痕迹
床下弓箭与红斗篷——他找到了 Red Riding Hood
